appearance.densityHint: How river cards are laid out on Home.

themeHints.system: Match your OS setting, and switch automatically when it changes.

appearance.languageHint: The language of menus, dialogs, and messages. Feed text stays as it is.
appearance.languageBetaHint: A machine drafted this translation and no native speaker has checked it yet. You can fix it with a pull request.

reading.markScrollHint: An item is marked read once it scrolls above the top of the list.
reading.hideReadHint: Read items leave the river instead of staying dimmed.
reading.keyboardHint: j / k to move between items, Esc to leave the reader.
reading.externalHint: Clicking an item opens its source link instead of the built-in reader.

refreshing.refreshHint: How often Monfil checks your feeds for new items.
refreshing.onLaunchHint: Also refresh once immediately when Monfil starts.
refreshing.keepHint: Remove older articles after this many days. Keep at least 10 per feed.

privacy.share: Share anonymous usage stats and error reports
privacy.unavailable: This build of Monfil does not collect usage stats or error reports.
privacy.shareHint: Send one daily count of the features you use, and a report when Monfil fails. No feed, article, or search text leaves your device. Turn it off at any time to stop sending and delete the counts kept on this device.

diagnostics.detailedHint: Record debug details in the local log file. Feed names, full links, article text, credentials, and file paths are removed.

analyticsCard.label: Usage stats and error reports
analyticsCard.title: Help improve Monfil
analyticsCard.body: Share anonymous usage stats (one daily count of the features you use) and error reports (the technical details of a failure). No feed, article, or search text leaves your device. You can change this in Settings at any time.

analyticsPreview.title: What is sent
analyticsPreview.body: Monfil sends one summary like this for each day you use it. It holds counts and settings. It holds no feed, article, search text, or name.
analyticsPreview.errorBody: When Monfil fails, it sends a report like this one. This sample is built on this device from a made-up failure. File paths, links, and email addresses are removed.
